family_reports.body: The family court has stolen time with my kids memories I can never get…
On false allegations with no evidence, I was reduced from full physical and legal…
I now have two emotionally damaged children and have been barred from helping them.…

public_comments.comment_text: Issued a three-year restraining order with no history of abuse based on a three week old Facebook post that opposing party was blocked from seeing. Made a rush judgment to label father a vexatious litigant without allowing the father to be heard. Continue to fail to view evidence that would exonerate father 100%. More violations of due process.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent
